referees.quote: There are a few major aspects the authors can improve before further consideration of this manuscript.
I recommend that the manuscript be accepted after major revisions of the written text to improve clarity.

I believe this manuscript presents extensive novel experiments that will be of great interest to the community, I have some issues regarding the clarity of the arguments and calculations that I feel should be addressed before publication

note: The file does not indicate a transfer from another journal. The first round (Version 0) has reports from Reviewers 1–3. R1's request rests on 'major aspects' to fix before 'further consideration', plus a requested experiment and analysis separating electric-field and doping effects, so it is inferred as major revision. R3 supports publication but asks mostly for clarifications, comments and corrections, with no new data required, so it is inferred as minor revision; this is a judgement call given the number of points raised. Reviewer 4 appears only in the second round (Version 1), with no first-round report, so is not listed. R1 did not submit a second-round report.
